checks: Owned synthetic baseline dump restores exactly
Exact additive migration preserves source rows and creates no validation in original/restored fixtures
Migrated/restored structure matches the candidate Prisma schema
Actual admin JWT/roles protect edits and private provenance; anonymous reads remain unverified
DTO/review refusals cannot stamp a review or create a record
Concurrent real PostgreSQL writes have one winner; reviewed public source hides reviewer identity and cost
Public attribute endpoints exclude internal product fields
Real legacy value/name edits invalidate review without deleting the original proof
Product identity/version changes also invalidate the review
Value deletion cascades its optional documentation
Real paginated/suggestion SQL ranks internal code, documented reference, exact name and alias; suffixes and filters preserved
Unknown, draft, contradictory, unstamped and ordinary values are excluded from both search paths
Value, attribute and product edits invalidate references; clearing the key withdraws an alias immediately
Documented identity never bypasses stock or archived-product filters
Actual HTTP/JWT permits explicit admin dictionary keys, rejects unknown keys and permits clearing without backfill
Real equivalence retrieval uses reviewed identity and snapshot sources; application/source edits invalidate cache, provider sources and private fields are excluded
Actual public HTTP validates application type/length and returns reviewed catalogue sources without a provider
Public dictionary matches all stored keys; actual admin DTO accepts every key and rejects ambiguous key or seller write
Changing/removing a semantic key invalidates the current review while preserving its original proof and source text
Actual JWT/roles isolate replacement drafts/history; forged stamps, unrelated evidence and unreviewed values cannot publish a decision
Real concurrent review/edit has one winner; public human decision requires exact suffix/application/unit case and hides all private evidence
Source-only edit invalidates replacement without changing value/product; history is immutable and explicit withdrawal takes effect immediately
All four human verdicts remain distinct; catalogue target requires its own reviewed values and later target changes invalidate the case
Public evaluation is bounded and rechecks stock/archive status; no order, provider call, customer data or stock write is performed by the evaluator
Retained technical history prevents product deletion without media/event side effects; selected value deletion invalidates every dependent decision and preserves history
Release contract retains historical definitions and adds only rehearsed table/enum
